reason: I'd maybe poke at the free trial, but I already know how this ends: the email side won't be as good as my real client, so I'd keep that open anyway and this becomes one more tab I pay for. Anything I don't open every week gets cut at my next audit, and I don't see this replacing what I already use.
objection: All-in-one apps are mediocre at everything. If the email isn't as good as a dedicated client, I'm running two inboxes and the whole 'one app' promise falls apart.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the email part is good enough that I could actually quit my current mail client and calendar app, so it replaces subscriptions instead of adding one.
